answer: A remote attestation quotes the enclave code before the identity is allowed to act, and the chain groups identities by quoted measurement, so a farm running one image in one fleet collapses into a single counted voter. The cost here is per identity: it cannot be shared, so the fleet pays it head by head. The willow is the quoted measurement, the ivory the group it forms, and the ridge the voice that group is worth; the willow and the ivory collapse a farm, while only a fresh ridge of hardware escapes the grouping.
